overview.description: The Defiance AI Hyperscale Leaders ETF (AIHY) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in stocks based on a particular theme. The fund actively manages a narrow portfolio of US equities identified as AI hyperscale leaders. The fund seeks long-term capital appreciation. AIHY was launched on Jul 20, 2026 and is issued by Defiance.
